t: A pocket LoRa messenger with an e-paper touchscreen, keyboard, GPS, and battery.
steps: Buy the T-Deck Pro from the LilyGO store or a reseller such as Rokland. Pick the radio band for your country.
Choose the 4G or audio version with care. Choose the pre-flashed Meshtastic version for the easiest start.
Attach the antenna before you switch it on.
Charge it with a USB-C cable.
Switch it on and set your name and region.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install PlatformIO or the Arduino IDE and follow the T-Deck Pro repo quick start.
Turn on OPI PSRAM, 16 MB flash, and USB CDC on boot in the Arduino settings. Try a repo example first.
meta: Open Board. From $99.18. A few stores.
